EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today is {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Do you know
about this? It's a pretty big deal!
It's when we celebrate the moon!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}We're gonna have a great time 
looking at such a pretty moon!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hoy se celebra el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Tú lo
sabías? {{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Deberías, es un pasote! Es
un festival en honor a la luna y tal.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Buf, ya verás qué bien nos lo
pasamos con toda la fiesta que
va a haber. {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Qué locurón, tí{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per noi oggi è {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ne hai mai
sentito parlare? È un grande evento
nel quale festeggiamo la luna!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Passeremo una serata niente male
a guardare la luna! È davvero
affascinante, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heut ist {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Habt ihr
nich' auch so 'n ähnliches Fest?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Nacht des Herbstirgendwas?
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Egal!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sich den Mond reinzuziehen,
wird jedenfalls voll cool!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bunu biliyor
musun? Bizim için bayağı büyük bir olay!
Ay'ı kutladığımız gün!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Böyle güzel bir Ay'ı seyrederek çok eğleneceğiz!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}We have a special food that we eat
when we celebrate the moon's 
beauty.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}That's just what we do for {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
We have this rice-cake thing called
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}songpyeon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! It's so good!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I could eat it all day!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Como la luna está tan bonita hoy,
aprovechamos para comer una
cosa muy especial.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Así celebramos el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sí, comiendo unas bolas de arroz
que se llaman "songpyeon".
¡Están de vicio! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Y encima me
ponen atómica, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Vous dégustez des trucs spéciaux
pour célébrer la lune, chez vous ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Parce qu'ici, pendant {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}on
s'empiffre de gâteaux d'riz appelés
songpyeons ! Tu devrais goûter !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'aimerais trop avoir la chance de
tester les spécialités d'ta ville, un
jour !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Da te si mangia qualcosa
di particolare mentre si ammira
il bagliore della luna?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Qui da noi, funziona così il giorno
di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} mangiamo dei dolci
di riso chiamati {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}songpyeon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non mi dispiacerebbe provare
una specialità delle tue parti,
un giorno, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Esst ihr bei euch in der Stadt auch
kleine Klöße, um die Schönheit des
Mondes zu feiern?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Darum geht's an {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Wir
essen immer Songpyeon, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}das ist
so 'ne Art Reiskuchen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Voll lecker!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Habt ihr bei euch auch so was
Leckeres am Start? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ay'ın güzelliğini kutlarken yediğimiz
özel bir yiyecek var.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}'ta geleneğimiz böyle.
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}songpyeon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} denen pirinç lokmaları var!
Acayip lezzetli!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bütün gün yesem bıkmam!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Today is {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! It's when we
take some time to appreciate the
beauty of the moon!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Since you're here, you should hang
out and see what all the fuss is
about!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Hoy se celebra el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿No te parece una pasada
dedicarle una fiesta así a la luna?
Mira, ya que has venido, {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡deberías
quedarte para no perderte toda
la movida!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En ce moment, c'est {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ! Et si
j'dis pas d'âneries, chez toi vous
fêtez la lune d'automne{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Puisque t'es d'passage, tu devrais
rester jusqu'à la tombée d'la nuit et
regarder la lune avec nous !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Oggi è tempo di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! Durante
questa festa ci dedichiamo ad
ammirare la bellezza della luna!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Dato che sei qui, ti conviene restare
finché quell'astro luminoso non si fa
vedere. Così capirai di cosa parlo.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Heut ist {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Anderswo
feiert man ja ähnliche Feste.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bei euch doch auch, oder?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Heißt
eure Mondfete nich'{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Nacht des
Herbstmondes{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder so was?
Im Großen und Ganzen geht's aber
ums Gleiche!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Wo du schon mal da
bist, solltest du zur Party kommen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bugün {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! Ay'ın güzelliğini
takdir etmek için biraz vakit ayırdığımız gün!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Madem buradasın, sen de takıl ve neden
bu kadar sevdiğimizi kendi gözlerinle gör!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's kinda weird that your town and
my town exist under the same
moon.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Makes you realize how big the moon
is! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¿No te parece una pasada que
veamos la misma luna en tu
pueblo y en el mío?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Buf, imagínate qué grande tiene
que ser la luna, ¿eh?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu trouves pas ça marrant qu'on
célèbre la même lune dans tous les
coins d'la planète ?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est là qu'on s'rend compte à quel
point le monde est p'tit,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La luna che illumina la mia città
è la stessa che veglia sulla tua!
Che cosa strana!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Però mi fa riflettere... quell'astro
è davvero immenso, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Senin kasabanla benim kasabamın aynı
Ay'ın altında olması biraz tuhaf geliyor.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}İnsan Ay'ın ne kadar büyük olduğunu
fark ediyor! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}For {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}it's tradition to eat
a rice cake called {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}songpyeon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}We only make it once a year, and I
always end up eating way too much!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Have you ever eaten too much of
your favorite food?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Is there such a
thing as too much? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} lo típico es comer
unas bolitas de arroz que se
llaman "songpyeon".{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Como solo lo hacemos una vez
al año, ¡al final siempre acabo
poniéndome morada!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}A ti eso también te pasa, ¿no?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Seguro que también te pones
las botas, ¡ji, ji, ji!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pendant {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, la tradition veut
qu'on déguste des gâteaux d'riz
appelés songpyeons.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Vu qu'ça arrive qu'une fois dans
l'année, j'frôle toujours l'indigestion
avec les doses que j'm'envoie !
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Dis, y'a l'même genre de coutume
chez toi ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Insomma, quando da noi è {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
facciamo dei dolci di riso che
si chiamano {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}songpyeon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si preparano solo una volta all'anno
e io finisco col mangiarne sempre
tantissimi, forse troppi!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}A te è mai capitato di mangiare
troppo?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Ma poi, chi decide quando
è troppo? Mmmh... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}An {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} isst man traditionell
Songpyeon,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} das ist so 'ne Art
Reiskuchen.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Die gibt's nur ein Mal im Jahr,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} daher
überfress ich mich daran immer
total!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Gibt's bei euch in der Stadt auch so
'ne Tradition?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}} Überfrisst du dich
auch immer? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vise un peu l'engin ! Tu crois qu'on
voit la lune aussi bien dans ta ville ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En tout cas, prends tout ton temps
pour admirer le spectacle !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Guarda la luna! Chissà se quella
che si vede nella tua città è diversa
da quella che stiamo ammirando...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Beh, comunque sia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} finché rimani,
dovresti goderti quella che c'è qui!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}So I hear you have an {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}celebration in your town, but it's
not as huge as {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is for us.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}We all celebrate the same moon, so
I'd like to see how you do it in your
town someday! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me han contado que en tu pueblo
hacéis una cosa que se llama
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
Aunque, al parecer, no le dais
tanto bombo como nosotros
al {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}De todas formas, con lo que a mí
me gustan las fiestas... ¡tengo que ir
a ver la de tu pueblo sin falta!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ho sentito che dalle tue parti
avete un evento chiamato
luna d'autunno...
... anche se non è grande
come lo è il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} da noi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Alla fine la luna è una sola, ma non
mi dispiacerebbe festeggiarla come
fate voi, un giorno, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Was geht denn in der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Nacht des
Herbstmondes {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}so in deiner Stadt
ab?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich würd's mir schon gern mal
ansehen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wir feiern ja schließlich
denselben Mond! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Duyduğuma göre sizin kasabada {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}kutlaması varmış ama bizim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} kadar
büyük değilmiş.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
Hepimiz aynı Ay'ı kutluyoruz; bir gün sizin
kasabada nasıl yaptığınızı da görmek
isterim! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is a really big deal for us!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}The moon is an important part of it,
but you've also gotta just enjoy the
day! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}es superimportante
para nosotros!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La luna es la gran protagonista...
¡pero también hay muchas otras
cosas que molan!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} est un des plus gros
événements de l'année, chez nous !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La lune y tient une place
importante, mais c'est aussi une
fête très axée sur la famille !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}è un evento molto
importante per noi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La luna ha un ruolo fondamentale e
non vediamo l'ora che sia sera, ma
anche di giorno c'è aria di festa!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Chuseok {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist für uns ziemlich wichtig!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Der Mond ist natürlich der Haupt-
darsteller,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} aber der ganze Tag ist
wichtig! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Und das Essen auch!
